- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Open-source GIS tools can be used to create a comprehensive situational awareness system during natural disasters.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular open-source GIS tools include QGIS, GRASS GIS, and GeoServer.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] GIS tools can create maps and visualizations displaying information such as the location and severity of the disaster, the distribution of affected populations, and the location of relief resources.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] GIS tools can track the progress of relief efforts and identify areas that still require assistance.
